tools.name: check_lead_contact
tools.description: Can an insurance agent contact this lead, by manual call, autodialed or prerecorded call, or text, and when? Checks consent (does it name you, cover texts and automation), the National and state Do Not Call rules, state calling hours and call caps, licensed-agent exemptions, Medicare limits and lead

tools.name: check_lead_data
tools.description: Check a purchased insurance lead for bad data (invalid or fake phone, placeholder or throwaway email, test names, ZIP outside the claimed state) and get a return request for the lead vendor.

tools.name: check_outreach_message
tools.description: Check an insurance agent's text, email, call script or voicemail against TCPA, CAN-SPAM, unfair-trade-practice and CMS Medicare marketing rules. Returns what to fix, with citations.

tools.name: state_telemarketing_rules
tools.description: A US state's telemarketing rules for insurance agents: calling hours, Sunday and holiday bans, call caps, state Do Not Call list, automated-call law, call-recording consent and licensed-agent exemptions, each with its citation.

tools.name: check_calling_window
tools.description: Is a sales call to a person in this US state (or ZIP) inside federal and state calling hours at a given time, and when does it open next?

tools.name: insurance_lead_cost
tools.description: Cost per policy and break-even cost per lead for an insurance lead source, from cost per lead, contact rate, quote rate, close rate and first-year commission.

tools.name: lookup_phone
tools.description: Look up US phone numbers in NANPA numbering data, refreshed daily: the carrier the number block was assigned to, line type (mobile, landline, VoIP, pager, toll-free), rate center, state and time zone, and whether the exchange or thousands-block is unassigned (a number that cannot be in service). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_lead_data, check_outreach_message · Private data: check_lead_contact, insurance_lead_cost · Public sink: check_lead_contact, check_lead_data, check_outreach_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_lead_data, check_outreach_message · Private data: check_lead_contact, insurance_lead_cost · Public sink: check_lead_contact, check_lead_data, check_outreach_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
